verified_facts.text: The Mansion Bar sits in the heart of the historic 1925 estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the heart of the historic 1925 estate, the Mansion Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, an enviable wine list, and delicious seasonal fare.

verified_facts.text: Heritage Afternoon Tea is served in the 1925 Mansion Library, a setting inspired by the 16th-century Italian Renaissance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Served in the intimate 1925 Mansion Library, indulge in a timeless tradition in a 16th-century Italian Renaissance-inspired setting

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea brings heirloom organic teas, savory sandwiches, signature scones and pastries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in Afternoon Tea – heirloom organic teas, savory sandwiches, signature scones and inspired pastries.

verified_facts.text: The Mansion Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine with French flair, made from fresh, local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contemporary American cuisine infused with French flair and crafted from fresh, local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The Mansion Restaurant has a smart casual dress code.
The Mansion Bar's seasonal rotating menu uses local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: The seasonal rotating bar menu incorporates local ingredients thoughtfully paired with delicious light fare.

verified_facts.text: The Restaurant Terrace offers al fresco dining with seasonal cuisine in garden surroundings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy al fresco dining in the heart of Turtle Creek, where seasonal cuisine and garden surroundings create a setting for leisurely afternoons and evenings.

verified_facts.text: Terrace service is subject to weather conditions.
The Mansion has private dining rooms with a residential style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Comfortably sophisticated and residentially-styled, each of the Mansion's private dining rooms offer the perfect setting

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have garden views and residentially-inspired details.
verified_facts.excerpt: Southern-crafted rooms and suites with garden views and residentially-inspired details that feel like coming home.
Beautifully appointed rooms provide a timeless residential atmosphere with custom furnishings and gorgeous finishes.
